comment: Reference definitions for CloudWatch alarms. These are provisioned by Terraform (modules/monitoring/main.tf). This file is for documentation and review purposes.

alarms.name: starttech-alb-5xx-errors
alarms.description: Fires when ALB returns 10+ 5XX errors within a 5-minute window

alarms.name: starttech-backend-cpu-high
alarms.description: Fires when average CPU utilization of the ASG exceeds 80% for two consecutive 5-minute periods. Triggers scale-out policy.
alarms.action: Trigger ASG scale-out policy + SNS alert

alarms.name: starttech-alb-target-response-time
alarms.description: Fires when p99 target response time exceeds 2 seconds for three consecutive 5-minute periods
